senses.gloss: f. pl. (καταφοράς, acc. pl.) downward strokes, in gen. blows, lashes. Pesik. B’shall. p. 81ᵇ עשר ק׳ אתה לוקה וכ׳ thou art doomed to receive ten strokes,—they are the ten Egyptian plagues—, and to pay a fine &c.; Yalk. Ex. 225.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:5">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>בו״ר נותן ק׳ וכ׳</he> a human authority decrees lashes, so does the Lord; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:3">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>יש לו קטפירס</he> (read: <he>נותן קטפו׳</he>).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30:7">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> [read:] <he>לוקה ק׳</he> (not <he>לקח ה׳ ק׳</he>) receives a certain number of strokes; a. e.
